events.title: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors with an approved Georgia pilot
events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Grid Protectors，先在 Georgia 试点
events.summary: OpenAI launched Grid Protectors, a national program intended to make future compute campuses reduce demand during grid stress and sometimes supply on-site power or storage. The only finalized example is the approved 25-year Effingham County agreement: about 3.2 GW of planned demand, OpenAI-funded infrastructure and up to 1 GW of flexible demand response. The campus is still in development, so no operational curtailment result exists.
events.summary_en: OpenAI launched Grid Protectors, a national program intended to make future compute campuses reduce demand during grid stress and sometimes supply on-site power or storage. The only finalized example is the approved 25-year Effingham County agreement: about 3.2 GW of planned demand, OpenAI-funded infrastructure and up to 1 GW of flexible demand response. The campus is still in development, so no operational curtailment result exists.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Grid Protectors，计划让未来算力园区在电网紧张时降低负载，并在部分地区用现场发电或储能供电。唯一已敲定的案例是 Effingham County 的 25 年获批协议：规划需求约 3.2 GW，基础设施由 OpenAI 承担，最多可提供 1 GW 柔性需求响应。园区仍在建设，尚无实际削峰结果。
events.why_it_matters: For AI infrastructure planners and host communities, this turns grid flexibility from a general pledge into a named program with one approved utility contract. Keep it on WATCH until operating data shows notice time, curtailment duration, workload impact, emissions and realized customer savings.
events.why_it_matters_en: For AI infrastructure planners and host communities, this turns grid flexibility from a general pledge into a named program with one approved utility contract. Keep it on WATCH until operating data shows notice time, curtailment duration, workload impact, emissions and realized customer savings.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 AI 基础设施规划者和园区所在地来说，这把“灵活用电”从原则承诺推进到一个有获批合同支撑的项目。仍应 WATCH：要等真实运行数据说明通知时间、削减时长、workload 影响、排放和用户实际节省。

technical_details.program_stage: Announced national program; location-specific commitments remain to be finalized and disclosed
technical_details.georgia_pilot: Approved 25-year Effingham County agreement; campus remains in development
technical_details.flexible_demand_response: Up to 1,000 MW; operational performance not yet observed
technical_details.cost_allocation: OpenAI committed to full infrastructure and electric-service costs for the facility
technical_details.savings_boundary: $950M/year from 2029 is Georgia Power portfolio projection across large-load agreements and expected growth, not OpenAI-only or realized savings
technical_details.time_basis: OpenAI RSS published 2026-11-02T15:00:00Z; supporting Georgia Power contract statements were published 2026-07-22 and 2026-08-26

technical_details_zh.项目阶段: 全国计划已公布；各地具体承诺仍待敲定并披露
technical_details_zh.Georgia 试点: Effingham County 的 25 年协议已获批；园区仍在建设
technical_details_zh.柔性需求响应: 最高 1,000 MW；尚无实际运行表现
technical_details_zh.成本承担: OpenAI 承诺承担设施所需的全部基础设施与电力服务成本
technical_details_zh.节省口径: 自 2029 年起每年 9.5 亿美元是 Georgia Power 对大型负载协议组合与预期增长的预测，不是 OpenAI 单项或已实现节省
technical_details_zh.时间依据: OpenAI RSS 发布于 2026-11-02T15:00:00Z；Georgia Power 支撑材料发布于 2026-07-22 与 2026-08-26

events.next_action_zh: 等 Georgia 园区运行并披露削峰时长、通知时间、排放和实际节省后，再评估该模式。
events.next_action_en: Reassess after the Georgia campus operates and discloses curtailment duration, notice time, emissions and realized savings.

evidence.claim_zh: OpenAI 公告确认 Grid Protectors 的全国计划与 Georgia 试点定位；未来各地承诺尚未敲定。
evidence.claim_en: OpenAI confirms the national Grid Protectors program and Georgia pilot while stating that future location-specific commitments remain unfinished.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; future commitments are announced intent

evidence.claim_zh: Georgia Power 确认 25 年协议、约 3.2 GW 规划需求、最高 1 GW 柔性需求响应与成本承担；园区尚未运行。
evidence.claim_en: Georgia Power confirms the 25-year agreement, about 3.2 GW of planned demand, up to 1 GW of flexible demand response and cost allocation; the campus is not operating yet.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; operational performance and savings remain projections

changes.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Grid Protectors，并以获批的 Georgia 协议为首个试点
changes.summary_en: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors with an approved Georgia agreement as its first pilot

events.title: Anthropic discloses $17 billion quarterly revenue and $895 billion of compute commitments
events.title_zh: Anthropic 披露单季营收 170 亿美元与 8954 亿美元算力承诺
events.summary: Anthropic filed its first S-1 amendment with unaudited results through September 2026. It reports $17.0 billion of revenue for the third quarter and approximately $895.4 billion of compute and infrastructure commitments, including $447.5 billion expected before 2031. These are company financial statements and contractual commitments, not cash already paid or independently audited operating results.
events.summary_en: Anthropic filed its first S-1 amendment with unaudited results through September 2026. It reports $17.0 billion of revenue for the third quarter and approximately $895.4 billion of compute and infrastructure commitments, including $447.5 billion expected before 2031. These are company financial statements and contractual commitments, not cash already paid or independently audited operating results.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 提交首份 S-1 修订文件，补充截至 2026 年 9 月的未经审计业绩。公司披露第三季度营收 170 亿美元，并已签约约 8954 亿美元算力与基础设施承诺，其中约 4475 亿美元预计在 2031 年前发生。这些是公司财务报表与合同承诺，不等于已经支付的现金，也不是独立审计后的经营结果。
events.why_it_matters: For model buyers and infrastructure planners, the filing shows both the scale of paid Claude usage and the long-duration capacity risk behind it. Treat the figures as a capital-intensity signal, not proof that current growth or margins are durable.
events.why_it_matters_en: For model buyers and infrastructure planners, the filing shows both the scale of paid Claude usage and the long-duration capacity risk behind it. Treat the figures as a capital-intensity signal, not proof that current growth or margins are durable.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对模型采购方和基础设施规划者来说，这份文件同时暴露 Claude 付费使用规模与背后的长期算力风险。应把这些数字看成资本密集度信号，而不是增长或利润率可持续的证明。

technical_details.filing_stage: S-1/A Amendment No. 1 filed with the SEC; IPO pricing fields remain incomplete
technical_details.reporting_basis: Unaudited three- and nine-month periods ended 2026-09-30
technical_details.commitments: $895.4B aggregate committed spend, substantially all compute and infrastructure
technical_details.commitment_timing: $447.5B expected before 2031; most remainder expected from 2031 through 2045; $69.8B due in the following 12 months
technical_details.concentration: Top five customers were about 25% of nine-month revenue; CSP marketplaces were 44%
technical_details.accounting_boundary: Nine-month net loss includes $94.3B of fair-value changes in convertible notes, derivatives and SAFEs
technical_details.time_basis: SEC filing date is 2026-11-02; the filing provides date precision only, so no intraday publication time is asserted

technical_details_zh.申报阶段: 已向 SEC 提交 S-1/A 第 1 号修订；IPO 定价栏仍未填写
technical_details_zh.报表口径: 截至 2026-09-30 的三个月与九个月未经审计期间
technical_details_zh.第三季度营收: 截至 2026-09-30 的三个月为 170 亿美元
technical_details_zh.合同承诺: 承诺支出合计约 8954 亿美元，绝大部分用于算力与基础设施
technical_details_zh.承诺时间: 约 4475 亿美元预计在 2031 年前发生；其余大部分预计在 2031 至 2045 年发生；随后 12 个月到期约 698 亿美元
technical_details_zh.收入集中度: 前五大客户约占九个月营收 25%；CSP marketplace 占 44%
technical_details_zh.会计口径限制: 九个月净亏损包含 943 亿美元可转换票据、衍生负债与 SAFE 公允价值变动
technical_details_zh.时间依据: SEC 申报日期为 2026-11-02；文件只提供日期精度，因此不声称具体公开时刻

events.next_action_zh: 等正式定价文件和后续审计报表确认现金流、承诺条款与增长延续性后，再调整供应商集中度判断。
events.next_action_en: Wait for final pricing documents and audited follow-up statements on cash flow, commitment terms and growth durability before changing vendor-concentration decisions.

evidence.claim_zh: SEC S-1/A 原文披露第三季度营收、算力承诺、时间分布与收入集中度；报表为未经审计。
evidence.claim_en: The SEC S-1/A discloses quarterly revenue, compute commitments, timing and customer concentration; the interim statements are unaudited.

changes.summary_zh: Anthropic S-1/A 新增第三季度业绩与长期算力承诺
changes.summary_en: Anthropic S-1/A adds third-quarter results and long-term compute commitments
